scope: Complete child-only wrapper and corrected receipt-descriptor lifetime. The parent metadata controller is a separate source review.
independentChecks: Both whole source bodies were fetched and length/SHA256 checked.
One unique literal replacement changes only receipt open/latch/unmask nesting. Whole forward and inverse reproduce both exact sources.
Every byte outside write_receipt is unchanged; the corrected function closes an acquired descriptor even if pending SIGALRM raises during signal-mask restoration.

Fixed SOURCE identity is [2049,529231,16877,0,0]. Every directory component is opened via directory descriptors with NOFOLLOW/NOATIME. The source is metadata-only; the wrapper does not enumerate dependency contents.
unshare(CLONE_NEWNS) succeeds and the current mount namespace device/inode changes before any mount. The first mount operation recursively makes propagation private.
The fixed source is bound only to the precreated empty owned view. Bind remount requires read-only, nosuid, nodev, noexec and noatime.

Both before and after the durable receipt, view inode/device/mode/owner equal the exact source; fstatvfs reports ST_RDONLY; full mountinfo requires exact source root/device/filesystem and required flags.
Nested mounts below both source and view refuse. No shared/master/propagate_from option is permitted on the view.
Original source directory full metadata stays exact through pre-exec checks. Root/candidate descriptors and paths retain their initial identities.
Source, original view, candidate and root directory descriptors are O_CLOEXEC and explicitly closed before Go exec, so no writable pre-bind view descriptor is handed to Go.
READY means the pre-exec boundary only. A later failure returns nonzero and does not convert the receipt into Go/source/test acceptance.
One exact argv/cwd/ROOT and GOMODCACHE view are required. There is no subprocess or child creation: the wrapper execs the fixed Go metadata command in the caller-owned f9 group.

Mountinfo reads enforce a 1MiB ceiling before accepting each chunk; receipt serialization is capped at16KiB. Ten-second alarm plus per-step deadline checks cover setup/receipt; parent owns the later group deadline.

Receipt is exclusive, single-link,0600, fsynced and attributed immediately. Partial failures are retained, never removed or retried. The corrected outer finalizer covers all receipt-descriptor stages.

resolvedFinding.origin: Root independently found the receipt descriptor gap; E independently observed and agreed during the whole initial read.
resolvedFinding.before: Pending SIGALRM could raise at the first SIG_SETMASK before control entered the later fd-closing try/finally.
resolvedFinding.after: A single outer try/finally encloses exclusive open, ownership latch, mask restoration, write and fsync.

requiredParentJoins: Exact wrapper byte/hash admission before launch and final source audit.
Exact controlled environment, staged source/toolchain identities and caller-owned limits.
Read the complete bounded READY receipt and bind its source hash, source identity, view mount, fixed argv/cwd and original/isolated namespace identities.
Require normal actual command closure with no forced cleanup and positive group absence; READY alone is not success.
Independently compare the parent's actual mount namespace device/inode and relevant mount state before and after group closure.
Preserve partial receipt/raw log and return unqualified FAIL if wrapper setup, exec, Go metadata, resource observations or final persistence fail.
Count the receipt and all wrapper/source/cache outputs within the unchanged parent namespace cap and terminal reserve.
limitations: The guarantee is the fixed GOMODCACHE read-only bind view. It is not a general filesystem sandbox and does not claim all aliases of the underlying source are read-only.
Go module-source contents are not newly hash-qualified by the wrapper. Metadata discovery is not compilation or dependency-byte qualification.
Read-only namespace capability/installed syscall acceptance has not been executed by E or inferred from this source review.
The fixed source mount-root calculation is reviewed for the declared physical source; unsupported mount layouts fail closed.
All native/C20/E97/Swift23 resource and acceptance gates remain separate.
